org_limit.title: Org Limit
org_limit.description: The organization-level value for the same limiter type, for reference. `null` when the organization has no limit configured for this limiter type.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where `value` comes from. `organization` values are listed only when `include_inherited` is `true`, and then `value` equals `org_limit`.

value.title: Value
value.description: The workspace's value for this limiter type: the workspace-level override when `source.type` is `workspace`, otherwise the organization's value.
